I am constantly on the lookout for effective solutions to combat congested pores and occasional breakouts, the Ole Henriksen Daily D-Clog Pore-Clearing Cleanser has become a welcome addition to our skincare routine. This cleanser promises to deep-clean and clarify without stripping the skin, and after several weeks of consistent use, I can confidently say it largely delivers on those claims. The scent is a refreshing, subtle botanical aroma – not overpowering, but pleasant and invigorating, making the cleansing experience feel like a mini spa moment. The texture is a smooth, creamy gel that lathers into a soft, airy foam with just a small amount of water. What truly sets this cleanser apart is its blend of active ingredients. It features a potent combination of BHAs salicylic acid and gluconolactone, which are excellent for exfoliating both the surface of the skin and within the pores, helping to dissolve oil and dead skin cells.
